message: Hi, I'm a student with a r programming certification background. My overall academic average is 75.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Management and system developer. I want to become a Mobile Applications Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 5700 per year. I live in Coimbatore. I cannot leave my city.

other_constraints: Interested in Management and system developer roles

explanation:
This MCA program is highly relevant as it covers 'software_engineering' and requires a CS background, aligning with your technical interest. It also meets your academic average (75.8% > 74%) and stays within budget ($1350).

The MSc Human-Computer Interaction program focuses on design and software engineering, which is ideal for aspiring Mobile Applications Developers. It meets your academic average (75.8% > 70%) and is well within budget ($2250).

This MTech Computer Science program offers 'software_engineering' and 'data_science_analytics', providing a strong technical foundation for development. It requires a CS background (which you have) and is affordable ($2300).

The MTech Computer Networks program provides core networking skills ('networking_cloud') which are foundational for system development. It is affordable ($2250) and does not require a specific CS background.

While focused on data analytics, this MSc Big Data Analytics program offers strong technical skills ('data_science_analytics') and is highly affordable ($1300). It also requires a CS background and meets your academic average (75.8% > 62%).
